text: The second tank bloomed fastest: 3,527 alive at 1,320 s.
Pinnifrons plisitricrens: leaves with a hinge, 354 alive.
At 118.5 s, one of its children lost the hinge.
That child's line, Lamina taplenegax, already has 589.
The second tank at 12,500 s: 4,203 alive.
Lamina taplenegax, the line that lost the hinge, holds 44%.
At 8,577 s, one of its children got the hinge back.
Remiphylla pototrapa: 101 alive, living at the surface.
This one is 6,722 s old, the oldest of its line.
At 13,700 s, the second tank stopped.
Its recorder met a snow reading of minus infinity.
We do not know why yet.
